title: pubdoc doc.yml
description: An optional doc.yml beside a doc's parts. It can only narrow its project.yml, and give a template layout another template: fewer variants, layouts or publications, narrower readers, and review steps that keep every project step and may only add checkers, reviewers or steps.

variants.description: The project variants this doc has.

layouts.description: The project layouts this doc is rendered in.

templates.description: Another template for a layout of the project's that a template renders, by layout name: a template pubdoc carries, or a path (holding a /) relative to the doc's directory to a template directory in the repository.
